# Docsynecx

> AI-powered document automation and workflow intelligence platform for finance and logistics operations connected directly to TallyPrime, Zoho Books, and CargoWise.

Docsynecx eliminates manual data entry by extracting, validating, reconciling, and syncing high-volume business documents with human-in-the-loop review.

## Core Pages
- [Home](https://docsynecx.com/): AI finance and logistics document automation platform.
- [About](https://docsynecx.com/about/): Company background, SynecX AI Labs Private Limited mission, and leadership.
- [Pricing](https://docsynecx.com/pricing/): Transparent pricing plans for growth, mid-market, and enterprise workloads.
- [Request Demo](https://docsynecx.com/demo/): Schedule an interactive live workflow demo.
- [Contact Us](https://docsynecx.com/contact/): Get in touch with product specialists and customer support.

## Finance Desk
- [Finance Desk Overview](https://docsynecx.com/finance-desk/): Autonomous document intake, OCR verification, and 2-way sync with TallyPrime and Zoho Books.
- [Invoice Processing](https://docsynecx.com/finance-desk/invoice-processing/): Read line items, calculate taxes, match POs, and post vouchers without typing.
- [Banking Reconciliation](https://docsynecx.com/finance-desk/banking-reconciliation/): Automated multi-bank statement parsing and ledger match reconciliation.
- [Payment Reminders](https://docsynecx.com/finance-desk/payment-reminders/): Intelligent debtor aging analysis and automated payment reminders.
- [Accounts Payable](https://docsynecx.com/finance-desk/accounts-payable/): Streamline vendor bills, approvals, audit trails, and payment scheduling.
- [For Business Owners](https://docsynecx.com/finance-desk/business-owners/): Real-time cashflow visibility, dues tracking, and oversight without manual reports.
- [For Finance Teams](https://docsynecx.com/finance-desk/finance-teams/): Accelerate month-end closing and eliminate manual voucher entry backlogs.
- [For Accounts Teams](https://docsynecx.com/finance-desk/accounts-teams/): Fast document ingestion, duplicate checks, and verified bookkeeping.
- [For CA Firms](https://docsynecx.com/finance-desk/ca-firms/): Multi-client document audits, GST verification, and high-speed reconciliation.
- [TallyPrime Integration](https://docsynecx.com/finance-desk/#integration-tally): Direct connection with TallyPrime for automated voucher posting.
- [Zoho Books Integration](https://docsynecx.com/finance-desk/#integration-zoho): Native sync with Zoho Books for bills, invoices, and bank feeds.
- [Custom ERP Integration](https://docsynecx.com/finance-desk/#integration-erp): Enterprise REST API and webhook connectors for proprietary ERPs.

## Logistics Desk
- [Logistics Desk Overview](https://docsynecx.com/logistics-desk/): Connected freight workflows converting emails into CargoWise jobs and quotes.
- [RFQ to Booking](https://docsynecx.com/logistics-desk/rfq-to-booking/): Read freight inquiry emails, attachments, and turn them into validated CargoWise jobs.
- [Shipment Operations](https://docsynecx.com/logistics-desk/shipment-operations/): Automate bills of lading, packing lists, air waybills, and customs declarations.
- [Shipment Tracking](https://docsynecx.com/logistics-desk/shipment-tracking/): Real-time container milestones, status aggregation, and exception alerts.
- [Freight Intelligence](https://docsynecx.com/logistics-desk/freight-intelligence/): Rate analytics, margin rules, and carrier quotation insights.
- [For Freight Forwarders](https://docsynecx.com/logistics-desk/freight-forwarders/): Win more shipments, enforce margin rules, stop margin leaks, and scale without adding headcount.
- [For Pricing & Sourcing](https://docsynecx.com/logistics-desk/pricing-sourcing/): Normalize carrier tariffs, compare multi-carrier buy rates, and draft quotes in minutes.
- [For Operations Teams](https://docsynecx.com/logistics-desk/operations-team/): Eliminate manual keying into CargoWise, validate B/Ls, and track container milestones.
- [Integrations](https://docsynecx.com/logistics-desk/integrations/): Native connectors for CargoWise, custom ERPs, EDI, and email workflows.

## Industry Solutions
- [Solutions Overview](https://docsynecx.com/solutions/): End-to-end document workflows customized for operational verticals.
- [Automotive & EV](https://docsynecx.com/solutions/automotive-ev/): Monthly spares, service, dealer, and purchase bill automation.
- [Industrial Manufacturing](https://docsynecx.com/solutions/industrial-manufacturing/): Complex multi-vendor asset bills, material receipts, and PO validation.
- [Textile & Garments](https://docsynecx.com/solutions/textile-garments/): Multi-currency export manifests, supplier invoices, and fabric lot matching.
- [Retail & Distribution](https://docsynecx.com/solutions/retail-distribution/): Fast invoice auditing, delivery challan verification, and credit notes.
- [Freight Logistics](https://docsynecx.com/solutions/freight-logistics/): Freight forwarding document intake, quotation rules, and customs filings.
